summary: Willamette NF lookout site in Lane County, OR: open-wall shelter with a firefinder built 1930, removed or destroyed 1970; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Open-wall shelter with a firefinder on the roof
facts.status_note: Shelter removed or destroyed in 1970; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Open-wall shelter with a firefinder (alidade) on the roof
Used as an emergency lookout (Oregon lookout history)
Register and Oregon history say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed

evidence.supports: about 13 miles southwest of McKenzie Bridge

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1930 build and 1970 end but disagree on removed (register, Oregon history) vs destroyed (firelookout.com); the story says so. No source describes the site today or public access, so no access or visit facet was written. Staffing: the only staff-related item is the emergency-lookout use, kept as an 'other' event. Brief record (gone, 2011 registration, USFS, 928 m) is consistent with the sources; no corrections. Two WebSearch queries turned up no page on the site today. No photos added.
